text: This guide explains how to deal with a pollen allergy in Germany.

Hay fever (HeufieberorHeuschnupfen) is an allergy to pollen. These are the symptoms:1 Runny or stuffy nose Itchy nose, eyes and ears Sneezing In Germany, hay fever season (Heuschnupfenzeit) starts around March, and ends around September.2It can be worse on certain months. It depends on the type of pollen you are allergic to. You can get hay fever in Germany, even if you did not have it before. When Imoved to Berlin, my hay fever became really bad.

There are different types of pills against hay fever.You can buy them without a prescription. If you go to a pharmacy (Apotheke), they will help you choose. Just ask forHeuschnupfentabletten. LoratadinPill. Around €10for 100 pills.3No prescription needed. This is what I use. It’s called Claritin in many countries.4It hasminor side effects. CetirizinePill. Around €8for 100 pills.5No prescription needed. It’s called Zyrtec in many countries.6It hassome side effects. LevocetirizinePill. Around €8for 20 pills.7No prescription needed. It’s called Xyzal in many countries.8It hasminor side effects. MometasoneNose spray. Around €12per bottle.9No prescription needed. It hassome side effects. You can buy pollen allergy pills in these places: In online pharmaciesTryShop Apotheke,dm-medandAmazon. It’s the cheapest option. At any pharmacy(Apotheke)

title: Does health insurance pay for it?
text: No.Public health insurancedoes not pay for allergy pills.10Private health insurancecan pay for it if it’s prescribed by a doctor.11

title: Can I deduct it from my taxes?
text: Yes.You can declare allergy pills when you file your taxes, but only if it’s prescribed by a doctor.12File it underaußergewöhnlichen Belastungen.

section: Other ways to treat hay fever
text: An ear, nose and throat doctor (HNO-Arzt) can test what you are allergic to. This helps you prepare better. There are immunotherapy treatments for hay fever. You must take a pill every day for a few months, or get a vaccine every few weeks for a few months. Yourhealth insurancepays for it.14

Use thepollen risk indextool from the German weather service. It shows you what types of pollen are in the air. This helps you find what type of pollen you are allergic to. Keep your bedroom windows closed, and wash your bedsheets more often.
